guide: Ten entries only. Gameplay aspect and the 5160x2160 output. The UI is centered later by the composition DLL, so the widget caves are not in this file.

memory.note: Gameplay aspect. Replaces 16/9 (39 8e e3 3f) with 3440/1440 (8e e3 18 40) in mov dword [rbx+4], imm32. This is the Hor+ world. Do not put 16/9 or the narrow factor back here.
Output size immediate: mov rdx, 3840x2160 becomes mov rdx, 5160x2160. Part of the mode change. Tested: it does not slide the UI picture. Leave it.
Same size immediate in rcx, 3840x2160 to 5160x2160. Does not slide the UI picture. Leave it.
Same size immediate in rcx, 3840x2160 to 5160x2160. Does not slide the UI picture. Leave it.
Resolution table. The 2560 entry becomes 3440. Neighboring 1600, 1920, 3840, and 2688 values stay. This feeds the mode the targets are created at.
Another mode pair. 2560x1440 becomes 3440x1440. The two zero dwords after it stay zero.
Scanout width: mov edi, 3840 becomes mov edi, 5160. Does not move the UI picture. Do not point it back at 1920.
Second scanout width, same 3840 to 5160 change. Does not move the UI picture.
The code used to load a width from [rbp-0x114]. This forces esi to 5160. It is part of creating the wide target, not the HUD centering shift.
